risks.title: Raw Materials Availability and Costs
risks.score_rationale: Raw materials represent PPG's single largest production cost component. Supply disruptions and price volatility directly impact profitability and operational efficiency.

risks.title: Macroeconomic Risks
risks.score_rationale: Global economic uncertainty, interest rate fluctuations, geopolitical tensions and trade policy changes directly affect demand for PPG products across multiple end-markets.

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: PPG's information systems and distributed manufacturing operations are vulnerable to cyber attacks that could disrupt operations, compromise data and damage reputation.

risks.title: Environmental and Regulatory Compliance
risks.score_rationale: Increasing environmental regulations, particularly around emissions and waste management, require continuous investment in compliance and operational modifications.

risks.title: Competitive Pressures
risks.score_rationale: PPG operates in competitive coatings markets where price competition, product differentiation and market share gains are critical success factors.

risks.title: Geopolitical and Trade Risks
risks.score_rationale: PPG operates globally with significant exposure to tariffs, trade tensions, sanctions and geopolitical instability, particularly in Europe, China and Russia.

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Volatility
risks.score_rationale: PPG's international revenues and costs are exposed to currency fluctuations that can impact reported earnings and competitiveness in local markets.
